How a line works: word, then thing, then key=value settings, then free words: set Lines at=40,40 · post "two words" · window.open feed to=left. A thing is named by its name or its id (dk74, shown in every answer); when two things share a name the answer lists their ids to choose from. Families are spelled family.word (window.move, task.add, theme.use); a plain verb (close, open, move, done) finds the family word for the thing you name. A receipt [r812] names a record; undo r812 takes it back. ; separates two lines. see words read and never change anything; do words act; hear words are things that happen (rules listen for them).
